question: For each port status, show the status and compute (1) the range and (2) the variance of the port standard attribute IDs, considering only ports that have a port binding on host 'drive-59' and excluding shared networks (i.e., networks whose IDs appear in networkrbacs with action = 'access_as_shared' for target tenant '*' or '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b'). Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
SELECT p.status AS port_status,
       MAX(p.standard_attr_id) - MIN(p.standard_attr_id) AS id_range,
       VARIANCE(p.standard_attr_id) AS id_variance
FROM ports p
JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
WHERE b.host = 'drive-59'
  AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT nr.object_id
      FROM networkrbacs nr
      WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
GROUP BY p.status

       MAX(p.standard_attr_id) - MIN(p.standard_attr_id) AS range,
       (SUM(p.standard_attr_id * p.standard_attr_id) - SUM(p.standard_attr_id) * SUM(p.standard_attr_id) / COUNT(p.standard_attr_id)) / COUNT(p.standard_attr_id) AS variance
FROM ports p
JOIN ml2_port_bindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
WHERE b.host = 'drive-59'
  AND p.network_id NOT IN (
      SELECT object_id FROM networkrbacs
      WHERE action = 'access_as_shared'
        AND target_tenant IN ('*', '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
GROUP BY p.status;

persistent_recovery_advisory_draft.base_sql:
SELECT p.status AS port_status,
       MAX(p.standard_attr_id) - MIN(p.standard_attr_id) AS id_range,
       VARIANCE(p.standard_attr_id) AS id_variance
FROM ports p
JOIN ml2_port_bindings pb ON p.id = pb.port_id
JOIN networks n ON p.network_id = n.id
WHERE pb.host = 'drive-59'
  AND n.id NOT IN (
    SELECT nr.object_id
    FROM networkrbacs nr
    WHERE nr.action = 'access_as_shared'
      AND (nr.target_tenant = '*' OR nr.target_tenant = '9f13bf11e06e4d81b44c8c3e62d4362b')
  )
GROUP BY p.status
